fields: (a steps block with holds): h, items [{t, d, hold, link}], ground, lane (optional: the water line's label, a drawing label, aria-hidden). A link makes the step's name the link.
best_for: CutoverSchedule sets how an upgrade runs as a schedule: each step a row with its bar on one shared, not-to-scale timeline, a hold diamond where someone signs, and your system's water line above, broken only at the step that names a planned shutdown.

items.d: On site, then a costed options report in [report turnaround, working days].

A factory acceptance test (FAT) of modules and software keeps site work short.
By [installation scope] in a planned shutdown; flushed, sanitized and residual tested.
IQ/OQ of what changed, agreed sampling, updated drawings and procedures.
